# B's 500.00 USD sold at 1.40, drawing on the cost basis the transfer out of
# an empty A opened at B at 1.35. 500.00 at 1.35 is 675.00 of cost against
# 700.00 fetched, so 25.00 is realized, and C's cost basis is left whole.
#

#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.

	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:USD B -500.00 USD
		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "27/20"
